reviews.decision_reason: The selection step treats every corpus row as demand-bearing, but the supplied package only provides need text, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight. It does not include observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes, so the strict market-demand basis for selection cannot be verified from the available evidence.

Within the supplied evidence, normalization preserves the existing record identifiers and the full bounded set of eight selected needs without visible contradiction. It does not independently establish market demand, but that is upstream of this normalization boundary.

The provenance assembly output ranks the normalized records deterministically by the supplied provenance fields and preserves all eight record_id/source_id handoff records. No contradiction is visible in the supplied package for this boundary.
